create.name: Julia Cameron
create.bio:
Julia Cameron is the author of The Artist's Way, the 1992 book that framed creative work as a spiritual practice and gave countless readers a simple daily discipline for it. Over three decades she has written more than fifty books, among them guides to writing, collections of prayers and reflections on faith, books on money and prosperity, and a memoir. Alongside the books she has worked as a poet, playwright, songwriter and filmmaker, and she treats her own life as the testing ground for everything she suggests.

Her method rests on a handful of habits rather than theory: three longhand pages written first thing each morning, a weekly solo outing to feed the imagination, regular walks, and writing out a question so that an answer can be heard on the page. She presents these as a way of reconnecting with a creative source she is happy to call God or the Great Creator, while insisting that no one needs to call themselves an artist to begin. From her home in Santa Fe, New Mexico, she now teaches mainly through recorded video courses, alongside talks and live workshops held online and in person.

books.title: The Artist's Way: A Spiritual Path to Higher Creativity
books.author: Julia Cameron
books.description: Her best-known book, laid out as a twelve-week course. Each chapter takes up one theme, such as safety, abundance or faith, and pairs it with exercises built around morning pages and the weekly artist date.

books.title: The Artist's Way Workbook
books.author: Julia Cameron
books.description: A companion to The Artist's Way with room to write. It follows the same twelve weeks and gives space for check-ins, lists and the book's tasks, so a reader can keep the whole course in one place.

books.title: The Artist's Way Morning Pages Journal
books.author: Julia Cameron
books.description: A journal for the daily practice at the centre of her teaching: three pages of handwriting each morning, done without editing. It includes her short explanation of why the habit matters.

books.title: The Artist's Date Book
books.author: Julia Cameron
books.description: A planner for the second of her core habits, the weekly solo outing. It offers prompts and ideas for small adventures that refill the imagination, with space to record each one.

courses.title: The Artist's Way Video Course
courses.description: Julia leads viewers through the twelve weeks of The Artist's Way on video, one theme at a time, from safety and identity through to faith. It is recorded, so it can be followed at any pace, and access does not expire.

courses.title: The Right to Write Video Course
courses.description: A recorded course built on her book about writing. She encourages anyone who wants to write to start, and shares how she keeps a steady writing life.

courses.title: The Essential Tools Video Course
courses.description: A close look at the four habits behind her work: the daily pages, the weekly solo outing, regular walking, and writing a question to hear an answer. Filmed at her home, it answers common questions and includes some of her own poems and music.
